title: Lifestyle Assistant Specialist
description:

Full Potential Solutions (FPS) is a performance-based, analytically driven omnichannel solutions organization with operations in Waltham, MA, Chennai, India, Bogota, Colombia, and Manila, Philippines that puts culture and employees first. We are a rapidly growing global company, employing the best people, processes, and proprietary technology to deliver groundbreaking solutions for our clients and fulfilling careers for our employees.
We invest in our people and put culture first because we believe that happy, fulfilled teams deliver breakthrough results. FPS offers a competitive suite of benefits for our employees, including a lucrative compensation program, medical, dental, and vision benefits, and the opportunity for high-potential career growth with a fast-growing company.
Our Core Values:

• Integrity - Do what’s right for everyone: clients, shareholders, partners & colleagues, TEAM is more important than self, and create an atmosphere of mutual respect

• Excellence - Deliver exceptional client results, Reward and recognize performance, and Relentless pursuit of improvement

• Accountability - Act like an owner, take pride in our work, Measure results (your own and our clients), Be passionate

• Grace - Respect and appreciate differences, Care for one another, Humility, Make work personal

Our Mission : To create conditions within which people can thrive!
Duties and Responsibilities
Does your ability to see around corners and plan ahead make you the envy of your friend group? We want you to join our team!

We are looking for Lifestyle Assistant Specialist that can serve our members; you will be an integral part of our mission. You will be serving a broad range of personal tasks and working closely with the copilot and operations team to accomplish tasks on behalf of our members.

Tasks can span from organize information on a Google Sheet that we display to members; calling doctor offices, customer service reps, hotels, salons, etc. to gather information regarding to availability and pricing; creating and sending google calendar invites; finding gifts from our vendor approved sites and organizing the information to present to members. For now, the agent will not be communicating directly with our members; but will be communicating with other vendors and businesses for information collection.
Qualifications

• Excellent English speaking and writing skills.

• Highly organized, detailed oriented and tech-savvy.

• Has great time-management skills and is very conversational.

• High deductive reasoning skills and proactive problem solver.

• Smart, strategic thinker and a tactical executer.

• Is "in-the-know" of great spots and enjoys being creative.

• Clear track record of exhibiting Full Potential core values.

• Empathizes with the program's mission of empowering working parents and democratizing access to personal assistants.

• Must be willing to go through pre-employment background and drug screening.

• Must be willing to work in a shifting schedule - availability for evening, night, weekend, and holiday shifts.

Technical Skills & ISP Requirements

• Typing speed of at least 35 WPM.

• Superior web navigation and computer skills.

• Experience in using G- Suite, Zendesk will serve as an advantage.

title: Principal Ontologist and Graph Modeler

Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
The Principal Ontologist and Graph Modeler is responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing enterprise semantic models, ontologies, and knowledge representations that provide meaning, context, and explainability for AI-driven analytics, agentic systems, and decision automation across the Business Insurance data portfolio.

This role ensures that Business Insurance concepts, entities, relationships, metrics, rules, and behaviors are explicitly modeled and consistently applied across data products and AI systems. The role enables reuse, trust, reasoning, semantic interoperability, and scalable AI adoption across underwriting, policy, claims, distribution, customer, product, and portfolio domains.

Operating at the intersection of business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, this role translates complex insurance domain knowledge into production-ready semantic assets that are consumable by both humans and machines.
Job Responsibilities:

• Lead the design and execution of enterprise-scale semantic layers for the Business Insurance data portfolio to standardize business meaning and enable trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases.

• Define and operationalize ontologies, context graphs, and knowledge graphs across Business Insurance domains to power reasoning, explainability, and decision intelligence.

• Model core insurance concepts and relationships spanning customers, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance.

• Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics by ensuring large language models and agents can consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships.

• Define canonical semantic vocabularies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured Business Insurance data sources.

• Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, governance, security, and lifecycle management.

• Define and promote standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, and ontology reuse across delivery teams.

• Work closely with AI Data Architects and AI Data Engineers to operationalize ontologies through graphs, metadata services, APIs, and production data platforms.

• Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards.

• Enable explainability by ensuring AI and analytical outputs can be traced to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data.

• Serve as the principal authority for semantic engineering, ontology, and graph-modeling practices supporting the Business Insurance data portfolio.

• Advance agentic data engineering through reference patterns, playbooks, proofs of value, and production deployments.

• Contribute to communities of practice, reference guidance, reusable assets, and internal enablement materials.

• 8-12+ years of hands-on experience in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale.

• Deep, hands-on expertise with RDF, OWL (OWL 2), RDFS, SKOS, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards.

title: Network Engineer (Journeyman)
description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Network Engineers provide hands-on technical support for Cisco Nexus and Application Centric Infrastructure environments, top-of-rack switching, and data-center connectivity, supporting installations, technology refreshes, maintenance, outages, and equipment-relocation cutovers. They work with senior network engineers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, Government stakeholders, vendors, and the Outage Response Team to maintain secure, reliable, and resilient network services.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

• Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Nexus data-center switching environments and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) fabrics, including APICs, tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, and external connectivity.

• Install, configure, refresh, and troubleshoot top-of-rack and data-center switches, network appliances, and software-defined networking configurations.

• Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port channels, virtual port channels, routing, access controls, and redundant paths supporting servers, storage, virtualization, cloud, and enterprise networks.

• Gather requirements and assist with implementation procedures, cutover plans, validation steps, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.

• Execute approved installations, configuration changes, refreshes, and hardware replacements, including relocation cutovers at USMEPCOM and MEPS locations (staging, testing, and post-cutover verification).

• Coordinate with cabling personnel on rack layouts, patching, fiber, copper, and network drops; support site surveys and update network diagrams, as-built documentation, and equipment inventories.

• Test devices before production deployment and apply approved firmware, OS, and security updates in accordance with DISA STIGs.

• Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and faults; troubleshoot Layer 2/Layer 3, fabric, routing, latency, and packet-loss issues, including WAN, SD-WAN, firewall, VPN, wireless, and cloud connectivity affecting data-center services.

• Participate in Outage Response Team activities, support diagnosis, restoration, and root-cause analysis, and coordinate escalation with senior engineers, Cisco, DISA, carriers, and vendors.

• Support remote MEPS and other locations with router, circuit, firewall, VPN, ISP, and cloud-connectivity issues.

• Follow approved ITSM processes and maintain configurations, change records, test results, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge articles.

Education & Experience

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Networking, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Three (3) to seven (7) years of relevant network engineering, network administration, data-center networking, or enterprise infrastructure experience.
Preferred:

• Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus, ACI, software-defined networking, and policy-based data-center network architectures.

• Knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies, including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, VLAN routing, and Quality of Service.

• Experience supporting installations, refreshes, migrations, and relocation cutovers using method-of-procedure, test, rollback, and cutover documentation.

• Experience with network-monitoring, configuration-management, and observability platforms.

• Experience applying DISA STIGs and supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, and POA&M requirements in a federal or DoD environment.

• Familiarity with structured cabling, patch panels, fiber connectivity, and inside-plant infrastructure.

Certifications

• Required: Current Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification.

• Preferred: CCNP Data Center, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, Com

We are creating “financial infrastructure that works”, disrupting the financial services industry by offering innovative solutions designed to meet the distinct needs of - and real-world challenges faced on a daily basis by - our customers. The Assistant Controller will support the finance team in managing accounting operations, preparing accurate financial reports, and ensuring compliance with IFRS and local regulations. title: Construction Project Coordinator – Commercial Construction
description:

Intelus Agency is seeking an experienced Construction Project Coordinator to support an established commercial construction, renovation, and facility maintenance company serving the Twin Cities and surrounding communities in Minnesota and Wisconsin. This part-time remote opportunity focuses on implementing, organizing, and maintaining project management processes using Contractor Foreman.
Working directly with the client's internal team and reporting to the President, you will help establish consistent documentation, improve administrative workflows, and keep multiple construction projects organized and up to date. Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope.

• 2-5 years of relevant experience in construction administration, project coordination, or construction project management support.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, Outlook, and digital document management.

• A self-directed professional who identifies missing information, follows up independently, and takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.

title: Senior System Software Engineer - Datacenter Power Management
description:
NVIDIA is redefining accelerated computing and powering the next era of artificial intelligence. Our data-center platforms bring together GPUs, CPUs, networking, systems, and software to solve some of the world’s most exciting computing problems. We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join NVIDIA ’s Datacenter Performance and Power Management Software team. You will be responsible for architecting production software for datacenter power management controllers. Your work will also cover cluster- level dynamic provisioning and power-management control system technologies for next-generation data-centers.
You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. Your responsibilities will span the entire product lifecycle-from initial architectural design and pre-silicon validation through silicon bring-up, productization, and deployment in extensive data-center infrastructures. This is an outstanding chance to influence how next-generation NVIDIA GPUs provide top-tier performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.
What You’ll Be Doing:

• Architect, build, implement, and debug data center power and performance-management software, with particular emphasis on end-to-end power management at racks and data halls.

• Develop real-time controllers, policies, and mechanisms that dynamically optimize performance, power, thermals, and energy efficiency under demanding data-center workloads.

• Drive features across the full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, productization, and production support.

• Collaborate with GPU architects and hardware designers to define hardware-software interfaces and influence the power-management capabilities of next-generation processors.

• Analyze complex interactions among workloads, clocks, voltages, power limits, thermals, telemetry, and system-level policies.

• Lead the investigation and resolution of complex power, performance, stability, and reliability issues spanning firmware, drivers, hardware, and platform software.

• Develop validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance-per-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.

• Build clear architecture, interface, and compose specifications for new power-management features.

• Partner with geographically distributed architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data-center systems teams.

What We Need to See:

• BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field-or equivalent experience.

• At least 12+ years of extensive industry experience crafting system software, embedded firmware, device drivers, or other hardware-related production software.

• Strong programming skills in C, including experience developing, debugging, and maintaining complex low-level software.

• Deep understanding of operating-system fundamentals, device-driver architecture, embedded or real-time software, concurrency, interrupt handling, and hardware programming.

• Experience interpreting hardware specifications and developing software interfaces for registers, telemetry, interrupts, and control mechanisms.

• Strong understanding of computer architecture and hardware-software interactions.

• Proven ability to independently debug complex problems across multiple software and hardware layers.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across organizational and geographic boundaries.

Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd:

• Background with architecting, designing, or implementing datacenter provisioning, monitoring, and managing power at a CSP/NCP.

• Hands-on experience with GPU, CPU, accelerator, or SoC power and performance management.

• Background with crafting or implementing P-state selection, DVFS, clock-control, voltage-control

Metrics, insights and continuous improvement

description: About Grubel Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. title: Dutch Speaking Rust Coding Evaluation Specialist
description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Languages: Dutch

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$80-US$92.5 per hour

• Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Dedrone protects airspace from drone threats. Each deployment combines our software, our own and partner sensors, and a networking stack that connects the site to DedroneC2 in the cloud. As Engineering Manager for Forward Deployed Engineering, you lead the team that owns the technical outcome at our most critical customer sites.

Your team takes each problem from live triage to a fix in the product. You have the authority to raise defects and to join design reviews with our product teams, based on what your team sees first-hand in the field. One question guides the work: how do we leave the product better than we found it, so nobody has to work this issue again?

What You’ll Do 

Location:  Onsite at our Sterling, Virginia office 4 days a week, and on the road 50% of time
Reports to: Senior Engineering Manager
Direct Reports: 3

• Hire, coach, and develop software engineers and systems specialists across the US and Europe.

• Lead a team that resolves live site problems with customers and installers as they come in, and plan its workload and its place on the engineering on-call rota.

• Run strong operational practices: incident response, root-cause analysis, reviews after incidents, and risk reduction.

• Drive field escalations to resolution with product engineering teams, and make sure each root cause is fixed in the product.

• Own and improve the runbooks, checklists, and acceptance tests that make deployments repeatable.

• Work with sales, services, and support teams on customer deployments.

• Travel to customer sites and events when the work needs it.

• Use AI-assisted engineering tools in your daily work, and help the team adopt them well.

• Measure the technical results of the team and report them to senior leaders.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of software development experience, or an equivalent engineering background

• 2+ years in an engineering leadership role, hiring, managing, and developing engineers

• Technical judgment to review designs and code, and to work hands-on during a live incident

• Production operations experience, such as incident response, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and monitoring

• Linux and networking depth to lead live triage and to judge root-cause analysis

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows

• Clear communication with customers, installers, and senior leaders during live incidents, and experience of work across teams without direct authority

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Baseten’s revenue is consumption-based. Customers grow as their inference workloads scale, so forecasting and performance tracking go well beyond counting closed-won deals. You’ll partner directly with Sales leadership, RevOps, Finance, and Account teams to build the models that explain where revenue comes from, where it’s headed, and which accounts deserve attention. - Prior experience in Sales, RevOps, or GTM analytics at a SaaS, infrastructure, or usage-based company

- Familiarity with CRM data (Salesforce) and connecting it to product or usage telemetry

description:

Du führst Deine Kund:innen strukturiert und souverän durch den gesamten Vertriebsprozess - digital, telefonisch und per Video. Dabei nutzt Du Deine Vertriebserfahrung, um Entscheider:innen im Gesundheitswesen zu beraten, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und aktiv zum weiteren Wachstum von Doctolib beizutragen.

Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Eigenverantwortlicher Vertrieb: Du begleitest den gesamten Sales-Prozess - von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsanalyse und Produktpräsentation bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

- Umsatz & Wachstum: Du verantwortest Deine Pipeline, den Umsatz (MRR), Deine Kundenbeziehungen und das Wachstum in Deinem Vertriebsbereich.

- Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du analysierst die Bedürfnisse von Ärzt:innen und medizinischen Einrichtungen, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und überzeugst sie von unserer digitalen Lösung.

- Inside-Sales-Ansatz: Du führst Deine Kundentermine telefonisch sowie per Video durch und sorgst für eine professionelle und persönliche Beratung über digitale Kanäle.

- Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig in Salesforce und nutzt Daten, um Deine Vertriebsstrategie gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

- Seniorität & Verantwortung: Du bringst Deine Erfahrung aktiv ins Team ein, teilst Best Practices und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Sales-Prozesse.

- Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Marketing, Customer Success und Operations zusammen, um eine optimale Customer Experience sicherzustellen.

 

DEIN PROFIL

- Sales ist Deine Welt: Du verfügst über mindestens 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

- Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du überzeugst durch exzellente Akquise-, Discovery- und Pitching-Skills.

- Erfahrung im Abschluss: Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge im eigenständigen Management eines Sales Funnels und im erfolgreichen Abschluss von Vertriebsprozessen.

- Energie & Überzeugungskraft: Du verkaufst mit Leidenschaft, trittst sicher und professionell auf und kannst unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner:innen für Deine Lösung begeistern.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, verfügst über ein hohes Organisationsgeschick und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus.

- Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) ausdrücken.

- Für unsere internen Trainings, All-Hands und den Austausch mit internationalen Kolleg:innen ist es hilfreich, wenn Du Englisch gut verstehen kannst. Falls Du Dich sprachlich noch weiterentwickeln möchtest, unterstützen wir Dich gerne mit entsprechenden Lernangeboten. Perfektes Englisch ist keine Voraussetzung. Deine Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

- Teamorientierung & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dein Wissen mit anderen zu teilen.

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

 

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

- Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

- Eine private Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen, unter anderem Zahnreinigung

- 28 Urlaubstage plus 1 zusätzlicher Urlaubstag für jedes volle

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

title: Data Scientist
description:
⌘Role Overview
The Data Scientist is the first hire on the team whose job is to put machine learning into production , not just into a notebook. You'll build models that power product and other live flows sometimes surfaced to users in real time, not just reported on in a dashboard a week later.
The first flagship project is about personalization across the user journey: a model that decides, per user, what offer to show, wired directly into the product and lifecycle experience rather than sitting in a warehouse table. From there, you'll extend the same muscle: model → API → product surface to other high-leverage moments in the user journey.
You'll work hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering and Lifecycle marketing to ship models as features, not as reports. This is also a foundational role for the team's infrastructure: most of what Data does today is batch (dbt, Lightdash, BigQuery); you'll help establish our first real-time low-latency serving patterns on GCP and work closely with engineering on this.
⌘Key Responsibilities
1. Production ML Development

• Build, validate, and ship ML models (propensity, pricing/discount optimization, personalization, churn/LTV) that go live in the product, not just proof-of-concept notebooks.

• Own the full lifecycle: problem framing, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining.

• Write production-grade code (tested, versioned, reviewed) - you'll be shipping alongside Engineering, held to their bar.

2. Personalization across the journey: from paywall to lifecycle

• Design and ship the personalized discounting model: who gets what offer, and why, served at the moment of the paywall decision.

• Partner with product on machine learning experiment design (A/B, holdouts) to prove causal lift of the models, not just correlation.

• Build the measurement framework so pricing/discount decisions are defensible to finance and leadership.

3. ML Infrastructure & MLOps (GCP)

• Stand up our first low-latency model serving pattern on GCP (e.g., Vertex AI endpoints, Cloud Run, or equivalent)

• Define the feature pipeline pattern: what's precomputed in BigQuery/dbt vs. what needs to be fresh/real-time via Pub/Sub or similar.

• Set up model monitoring: drift, staleness, prediction quality so a live model doesn't silently degrade.

4. Product & Engineering Partnership

• Sit close to Product and Engineering, not just Data this role is measured by what ships to actual users, not just notebooks

• Translate a product problem ("how might we reactive lapsed payers") into a modeling problem, and a model output into an API contract Engineering can build against.

• Document handoffs clearly enough that Engineering can own the serving layer long-term without you as a bottleneck.

5. Experimentation & Causal Inference

• Design uplift/causal models where "who responds to a discount" matters more than "who churns" .

• Run and interpret experiments that isolate the model's actual incremental impact on revenue/retention.

• Design the experimentation program for improving data science and machine learning models with the same rigour we use across our already ongoing experimentation programs

⌘Expected Outcomes

•
Personalized discounting model live in production , serving real paywall decisions to real users: shipped end-to-end, not a prototype sitting in staging.

•
A documented, reusable low-latency serving pattern established on GCP (Vertex AI endpoints or Cloud Run) - the next model doesn't require rebuilding this from scratch.

Model monitoring in place - drift and staleness alerts mean the team knows within days, not months, if a live model silently degrades.

A repeatable model-to-production playbook that others in

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Position Summary
DataSpring runs the largest healthcare data foundation in the U.S. The Sr. Data Engineer builds and owns the pipelines and data models behind our provider data platform and the ProView suite. You will spend most of your time writing production code on Azure Databricks and Azure SQL: ingesting provider data from many sources, modeling it with history and lineage, and deciding which source wins when they disagree. You will also own our data modeling standards and the automation that enforces them, and review the data model work of internal engineers and vendor delivery teams.

The Sr. Data Engineer is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Senior Director, Data Engineering & Architecture.

Specific Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate production pipelines on Azure Databricks and Azure SQL that ingest, integrate, and publish provider data from internal and third-party sources.

• Design the data models those pipelines load, including integration and master-data layers with history (SCD Type 2), source lineage, and field-level survivorship rules.

• Write production-grade SQL, PySpark, Python, and DDL, and tune performance and cost on large datasets.

• Build data quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting so problems surface before customers find them.

• Own the data modeling and naming standards for SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), and build the automated checks in Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that enforce them.

• Review data models, schema changes, and pull requests from internal engineers and vendor teams, and record modeling decisions so they can be traced later.

• Maintain source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, and ERDs, generated from the systems themselves wherever possible so they stay current.

• Partner with Data Science, product, billing, and application teams to turn business requirements into data models and clear data contracts.

• Protect PHI (Protected Health Information), including classification of sensitive columns, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2 audit requirements.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None. This role sets technical direction for internal engineers and vendor delivery teams without direct reports.

Skills

• Expert SQL and strong PySpark and Python, with a track record of building and running production pipelines, not only designing them.

• Deep relational and dimensional modeling skills, including history (SCD), entity resolution, and knowing when each approach is the wrong choice.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, medallion architecture, job orchestration (e.g., Databricks Asset Bundles), and performance tuning.

• Git-based workflows and CI/CD in Azure DevOps or an equivalent platform, including database deployment automation with gated promotion across environments.

• Experience with data quality testing and pipeline observability.

• Ability to explain design decisions clearly to engineers, product owners, and leadership, and to hold a technical line with vendor teams while keeping the relationship productive.

Experience

Required:

• 8+ years in data engineering, including at least 4 years designing data models that reached production at scale.

• Recent, hands-on production engineering. You will be expected to write and ship code, not only review it.

• Demonstrated experience building master data management, entity resolution, or survivorship logic across multiple data sources.

• Experience defining data modeling standards and automating their enforcement.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred:

• Healthcare data experience, especially provider data, credentialing, or member eligibility data.

• Experience reviewing or directing the work of vendor or offshore delivery teams.

• Experience with data quality platforms (e.g., Ataccama) and data modeling too

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

LEAD AUTOMATION & CONTROLS ENGINEER, DATA CENTER FACILITIES

As a Lead Automation and Controls Engineer, you will design, program, commission, and own the controls for that plant. You will write robust control code, build operator interfaces people can trust, and take total ownership of live systems - tuning sequences, closing reliability gaps, and bringing new capacity online while the cluster is already in production.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, develop, and manage facility automation projects from sequence of operations and control narrative through panel build, point-to-point checkout, commissioning, failover testing, and handoff to operations.

• Architect, write, and debug PLC and controller code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable across chillers, pumps, cooling towers, coolant distribution units, air handlers, heat rejection, and related plant equipment.

• Implement lead/lag, staging, rotation, free-cooling, and liquid-cooling control strategies that hold capacity, efficiency, and redundancy (N+1 / 2N) as the cluster load changes.

• Keep the plant safe and reliable with fail-safe interlocks, emergency power off and transfer logic, and alarm philosophy that meets NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 75, and applicable life-safety requirements.

• Build clear HMI and control-room graphics so operators can see plant state, acknowledge alarms, trend equipment health, and troubleshoot without calling an engineer first.

• Integrate equipment controllers into the site BMS, EPMS, and historian so power, cooling, and environmental data are one operational picture.

• Design control panels and electrical interfaces compliant with NEC, NFPA, and UL 508A, including motor and VFD interfaces, safety circuits, and network architecture.

• Own the systems after go-live: alarm rationalization, loop tuning, sequence changes, outage support, and continuous improvement of uptime and energy performance.

• Build schedules and punch lists for controls scope and drive vendors, contractors, and internal teams to hit them during construction and live expansions.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, controls, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

• 3+ years of experience in industrial controls, building or plant automation, data center facilities, or related programming (internship and extracurricular experience applies).

• 1+ years of experience leading a project, team, or people

 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Energized by fast, iterative design, construction, and commissioning on a live critical facility.

• Proven ability to turn a messy plant problem into a simple, reliable control solution.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including control narratives, sequences of operations, and recommendations across mechanical, electrical, and operations teams.

• Judgment to move quickly while protecting people and equipment around high voltage, stored energy, refrigerants, fuel systems, and high-pressure hydronics.

• Experience in data centers, power generation, district energy, industrial utilities, or other 24/7 process p

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Job purpose
The Learning & Development Specialist designs, delivers, and scales impactful learning solutions tailored to the agile environment of a growing mid-sized company. This role drives organizational capability across all functional departments, including Client Success, Sales, Marketing, Human Resources, Finance, Accounting, and Executive Leadership. As BELAY’s owner of leadership development and training programs, the Learning & Development Specialist equips staff at every level with the skills, strategic alignment, and competencies needed to thrive in their current roles and advance within the organization.
Essential Functions
As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

• Design and facilitate core leadership development programs for managers, directors, and emerging leaders, focusing on emotional intelligence, coaching, performance management, and strategic decision-making. This role owns BELAY’s leadership and manager training programs.

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Education, Business Administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience
